fusions.name: Pancaking Slam
fusions.desc: A crushing slam that deals 20 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Levelling Stomp
fusions.desc: Stomps every enemy within 2.5 tiles; each hit deals 9 damage. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Weighted Swings
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Piling Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
